evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any other questions or concerns you would like answered on this call in regards to the move today? [asked after probing already started — rep had already confirmed contact details, email, and repeat customer status]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about $850 quote vs $650 last year: Rep followed up: 'Well, that's part of you booked online too so you didn't talk to like a human... Let me see if I can pull up your last move.' Then dug into the prior move duration (3.25 hours) and rate ($200) to contextualize the difference. Customer raised mattress frame concern: Rep asked 'What size bed frame is that?' and confirmed they do that service.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For the last move was $200... this move will be $208... I would estimate move between to take between two and a half to three and a half hours and so if we are at the minimum two and a half hour rate it'd be $520 and then if we hit the three and a half hour it would be $728. So, we are looking pretty much even if it took four hours... we're sitting in the range of what you paid last time. [Anchored to typical range for size + personalized to customer's prior experience and concern about cost increase]
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: No explicit ask for the business present. Rep moved directly into confirming arrival window and logistics without asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent.

top_strength: Excellent probing for logistics detail — systematically gathered property type, floor/access, walking distances, box count, special items (sofa, mattress frame, TV size), and destination details — and skillfully contextualized the estimate against the customer's prior move to address their price concern.
coaching_note: Section 1 missing: no quid pro quo framing (time-boxed, promise of dependable quote, real wait for yes); Section 4 missing the "Does that feel fair?" pause; Section 7 missing the explicit ask for the business and rate-lock mention; no active listening reflection in Section 2; no packing services offered; no catch-all item question in Section 6.
